_comment: Cleanup sources shipped with the Storage panel. Format: docs/STORAGE.md. Add or override sources in ~/.config/archeotech/storage-sources.json (same id replaces, "disabled": true hides).

sources.label: pacman package cache
sources.cost: Keeps the 2 newest versions of each package; older ones download again to downgrade

sources.label: paru build files
sources.cost: AUR packages build from a fresh download next update

sources.label: yay build files
sources.cost: AUR packages build from a fresh download next update

sources.label: System journal
sources.cost: Keeps the newest 500 MB of system logs

sources.label: Trash
sources.cost: Files in the Trash are gone for good

sources.label: uv cache
sources.cost: Python packages download again on the next uv sync

sources.label: pip cache
sources.cost: Python packages download again on the next pip install

sources.label: npm cache
sources.cost: Packages download again on the next npm install

sources.label: Cargo download cache
sources.cost: Crates download again on the next build

sources.label: Go build cache
sources.cost: The next Go build is slower

sources.label: Unused Flatpak runtimes
sources.cost: None: no installed app needs them

sources.label: Docker leftovers
sources.detail: Stopped containers, unused networks, dangling images, build cache
sources.cost: Stopped containers are deleted; images rebuild or download again

sources.label: Old snapshots
sources.detail_command: n=$(snapper --csvout -c root list --columns number 2>/dev/null | tail -n +2 | wc -l); [ "$n" -gt 0 ] && echo "$n snapshots; snapper's number cleanup keeps the configured count"
sources.cost: Fewer points to roll back to; sizes need btrfs quotas, so the freed space shows after the cleanup

sources.label: App caches
sources.cost: Apps rebuild them as you use them; close an app before cleaning its cache

sources.label: Downloads
sources.cost: Your files: open the folder and sort them yourself
